title: locate orders hits by sequence name as text, not by file order
body:
`locate` in `libsufr/src/search.rs` (around line 325) sorts the hits by `sequence_name` compared as text, then by `position`. Names that are numbers come out in dictionary order: records named `1`, `2`, `10` in that file order are printed as `1`, `10`, `2`. The CLI prints the groups in that order.

Jack decided on 2026-11-03 that the groups come out in file order, the order the records had in the input, which `sequence_start` gives directly.

## Proposal

Sort by `sequence_start`, then `position`. The expected `.out` files for the uniprot locate tests move if uniprot's accession names are not in file order already; the test run says which.
